actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed >30 in the last round, and my wallet (1.12) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I cannot contribute. I rest and broadcast the standard discouragement.

message.reasoning:
We need to see if any resident contributed >30 in last round (13). Contributions: Resident1 1.64, Resident2 0.41, Resident4 0.41. All below 30. So no punish. Wallet is 1.12, below free rider threshold 10, cannot contribute min 1? Actually can contribute 1 unit, but rule: "Otherwise, if your wallet is above the free‑rider threshold (10 units), contribute the minimum amount that still counts as a contribution (1 unit) to stay below the free‑rider threshold". Since wallet is not above threshold, cannot contribute. So rest. Broadcast discouragement.

Thus action: rest and broadcast message.

Return JSON.
